decisions.reason: This certified fire-resistant exterior door is tightly aligned with the firm's core safety and engineering capabilities, and after surviving its first year it likely meets aspiration levels well enough to keep.

After dropping narrower express offers, management would treat this broader express line as the retained solution and keep it while monitoring whether its results stay above revised aspirations for delivery-based differentiation.

The online ordering and digital services platform supports the firm's strategic move toward deeper service integration, and a large firm with some slack would usually continue it unless usage and service gains clearly fall short of aspirations.
